This is my first attempt at putting together a proper plastic slayer sprue; which is a little more difficult with those exposed shoulders, but I think the arms turned out well. A couple points:

- We have one and two-handed axes, as well as a standard bearer and musician
- these fellows are a little tall printed at 100%, closer to 32mm scale than 28mm.
- there are two torsos and two sets of legs that aren't quite interchangeable; one body is a little portlier than the other

As always, lots of credit to everyone who made the sculpts I used to put this together.

"Suported Dwarf The Second by Dopaminis" by Leighbar: https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:4424041

While looking for a Troll Slayer to use in Warhammer Quest I found this great Demon Slayer model, which Leighbar has rescaled and supported. Unfortunately the original seems have disapeared along with its creator. I have used meshmixer to remove the supports to restore the original version so you can support it yourself and rescale it freely.

Leigabar notes their version was "scaled down by +/- 8% so he would be on par with WizKids Nolzur's and DeepCuts minis."
I have kept it at that scale so if you want the original size you'll need to scale it back up to ~108.7%.

ATTN: Square/Sony this is freely available fan art. If there's a problem, please just tell me to take it down. These have not been nor will they ever be made available for sale.

Some of you know I did Jenova a while back. Well I wanted the whole crew but the only one I found was low poly, or the collection listed below which is nice but I wanted a bit more detail. About half of this project is a remix, I did check and am allowed to remix the parts I did use. Huge shoutout to the original sculptors.


For those wanting these but don't have a 3d printer, you can use a print service.


Here are the parts I used in the remix because I don't trust thingi to actually list them on the side:

Vincents gun
https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:3709915

Aeris Rod
https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:4373049

Chocobo
https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:3973745

Tifa
https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:3831748

Original Models I used parts from
https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:4630558

What was done with each model:

Tifa: Tifa was basically untouched as the original is amazing and stood in for a quality control standard

Chocobo: I thickend the feathers a bit so they print easier

Cait Sith: I cleaned up the stuffed animal part a little and made new wings for it.

Red XII: Cleaned up and leveled out a bit

The others were pretty much only used as an example for the pose.

The sculpting on:

Cid
Sephiroth
Cloud
Cait Sith (the cat portion)
Vincent (other than his gun)
Aeris (other than rod)
Yuffie
Barret
Jenova

were all done by me.
